title: contacts AddressBook/set cascade echoes backend Display in serverFail
description: crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/addressbook.rs:622 and :637 build serverFail with format!("cascade query failed: {e}") / ("cascade fetch failed: {e}"), echoing the backend error's Display to the wire. Violates the workspace redaction contract (SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC, server_fail_from_backend_drops_display_text, bd:JMAP-wlip.2). Fix: use server_fail_value_from_backend. Found while doing JMAP-yt1w.21; out of scope there.
